# Make targets

> Every `make` target in the Makefile, grouped as `make help` groups them, with the VS Code task that runs it — generated from the Makefile and `.vscode/tasks.json`.

`make help` prints the same list (Law AI — Docker-first development). Each target shells into `docker compose` unless its group says host; the rule is in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) § Docker-First Workflow. Edit the `help:` recipe or a target's comment in the [Makefile](../../Makefile), then run `python3 scripts/gen_make_reference.py`.

## Stack

| Command | What it does | VS Code task |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `make dev` | Start full stack (foreground, builds images) | Docker: Start Full Stack |
| `make down` | Stop and remove containers | Docker: Stop Stack |
| `make logs` | Tail logs from all services | Docker: Tail Logs |
| `make ps` | List running services |  |
| `make debug` | Start stack with debugpy/inspect attach ports | Docker: Start Full Stack (Debug) |
| `make debug-frontend` | Build/start debug stack detached until frontend is healthy | Docker: Build & Start Frontend |
